title: Migrate core resources (project, project_features, + data sources) to terraform-plugin-framework
essence: Migrates betterado_project (resource + 2 data sources) and betterado_project_features to terraform-plugin-framework, served through the mux provider alongside the remaining SDKv2 resources. Produces a gap matrix (docs/core-gap-matrix.md) comparing all core resource schemas against the ADO REST API v7.1. WI-4 through WI-9 (pipeline_settings, tags, team, team_administrators, team_members, client_config, docs) are deferred — WIs exited with status:failed; the deliverable for this PR is WI-1 + WI-2 + WI-3 (gap matrix + project + project_features).
